scope: Independent source and completed-raw-data audit of the source-order correction, two one-minute actual-app confirmations, one600-second actual-app soak and its separate lifecycle trial. No live browser, GPU, network or build activity was performed by this reviewer. This is not unrestricted deployment or performance promotion.

source_review.generated_copy_check: The recorded generated dispatcher and worker hashes match source-order-identity.json; their changed text is exactly the production correction,4 dispatcher edits and1 worker echo. The raw/tagged wire format and existing ordered channel are unchanged.
source_review.semantics: Every incoming image obtains a server-owned increasing source sequence before dispatch admission; rejected inputs may leave harmless gaps. After current-epoch pending/output/watchdog accounting, results at or below the last successfully sent sequence are discarded. Successful JPEG send advances the sequence before stats send; congestion and failed JPEG sends do not advance it. Prior epochs are rejected first; missing/invalid echoes are counted and rejected.
source_review.checker_validation: The new source-order checker reproduces2300/1383/2293 prior formal failures, accepts strictly increasing controls, and rejects duplicate/missing/reversed IDs.
source_review.diagnostic_limit: The existing framesToClient diagnostic increments after stats send; a successful JPEG followed by a stats-send exception can be absent from that counter. This does not compromise the source watermark or the independently counted client measurements.

identity.qualification: Saved process commands, workerGPU0/1 environments, source hashes and job options reconcile. The app/probe source is unchanged; the harness adds ordering checks. Both model workers are resident on the same two-GPU host, using the isolated newer stack and combined profile. No new runtime query was made during the audit.

archive.status: all archived data files match the completed local originals byte-for-byte after decompression; all8 raw hashes match archive.json

steady_checks.window_definition: For each trial,max(main.started,stage.started) through min(main.at,stage.at). FPS is unique IDs divided by that observed elapsed time; all counts,percentiles,means,dimensions and worker gaps recompute from this common interval.
steady_checks.capture_order_definition: For each aged event,source capture time is reconstructed as at-ageMs. Every observed capture sequence is strictly increasing,with no tolerance needed. Minimum positive step across the steady streams is15.89990234375ms.
steady_checks.metadata_integrity: Every formal aged preview/stage source ID resolves to a recorded main receipt; source capture timestamps agree within0.7001953125ms,consistent with separate sampling of epoch() in record/age fields. The correction is therefore verified beyond monotonic probe IDs.
steady_checks.health: All three trials have both expected worker IDs,combined/cuda-events telemetry,the requested decoded dimensions,no probe/compile/connection errors,and an open main channel. All per-worker output gaps remain below2seconds.

conclusions: The original cross-GPU reversal is absent in all three corrected actual-app steady trials and the complete scripted lifecycle test,both by source IDs and reconstructed capture timestamps. This verifies the bounded ordering correction for the tested ordered-channel configuration.

At768x448,the observed600.2529second run records16182 receipts,12923 preview RAF observations and16044 stage submissions:26.9586/21.5293/26.7287FPS. Stage age p95 is284.9850ms,p99329.8570ms,max532.2002ms. These are actual app instrumentation results at their stated boundaries.

The512x288 one-minute confirmation records33.5358 received/26.2440 preview RAF/32.6389 stageFPS;1024x576 records17.0235/15.3295/17.0069FPS. They are single confirmations,not repeated per-size performance estimates.

Compared with the earlier failed-ordering soak,lower stage FPS and improved tail ages are sequential observations. Rejecting older output is a verified correctness change; the entire latency difference cannot be causally assigned to it because transport/time also changed. No original failed evidence is replaced.

The real analyser responds to synthetic WebAudio gains0/0.2/0.6 with median RMS0/0.14125/0.42444 in the long run. Transition samples remain:one gain0 sample reaches0.2813 and the gain0.2 minimum is0. These commanded-level groups are not instantaneous settled-level guarantees.
limitations: Preview RAF observes a currently loaded image at an animation-frame callback;stage GL records final framebuffer submission. Neither proves compositor/physical projector presentation or completion of GPU display work.

Age starts at canvas encode initiation,excluding prior audio acquisition/canvas copying and physical presentation. Synthetic oscillator MediaStreams exercise real WebAudio analysis,not a physical microphone/device path.
The1920x1080 stage viewport differs from the actual GL buffer:2048x1152 for512/1024generated sizes,2304x1344 for768. All dimensions are retained.

The768preview is21.529FPS despite26.729stage submissions/s. A60FPS capture setting produced only about37–38sends/s; these confirmations do not establish30FPS preview or the standalone57FPS transport rate in the actual app.

The corrected one-minute confirmations and ten-minute soak are not matched repeated before/after timing experiments. They validate observed functionality/order/stability for this fixture and profile,not universal speed,quality equivalence or all workloads.
The stress reconnects take about11.15–11.18seconds. Passing recovery is not a low-latency reconnection claim. Deliberate stress pauses are excluded from steady FPS.
This audit does not establish source ordering for an unordered transport channel;the production path tested here is ordered.
